panels.title: Pods Running
panels.description: Number of pods in Running phase (phase=2)

panels.title: Pods Pending
panels.description: Number of pods in Pending phase (phase=1)

panels.title: Pods Failed
panels.description: Number of pods in Failed phase (phase=4)

panels.title: Container Restarts
panels.description: Total container restart count across selected namespaces

panels.title: Active Namespaces
panels.description: Number of namespaces in Active phase (phase=1)

panels.title: Nodes Ready
panels.description: Number of nodes with condition_ready=1

panels.title: Disk Pressure
panels.description: Number of nodes with disk pressure condition active

panels.title: Memory Pressure
panels.description: Number of nodes with memory pressure condition active

panels.title: PID Pressure
panels.description: Number of nodes with PID pressure condition active

panels.title: Network Unavailable
panels.description: Number of nodes with network unavailable condition active

panels.title: Non-Ready Nodes
panels.description: Nodes where condition_ready is not 1. Empty table means all nodes are healthy

panels.title: Cluster Memory Utilization
panels.description: Cluster-wide memory working set as a percentage of allocatable memory

panels.title: Cluster CPU Utilization
panels.description: Cluster-wide CPU usage as a percentage of allocatable CPU

panels.title: Cluster Filesystem Utilization
panels.description: Cluster-wide filesystem usage as a percentage of total capacity

panels.title: Cluster Network I/O
panels.description: Aggregate cluster network receive and transmit rates across all nodes

panels.title: Disk Usage (Worst)
panels.description: Highest disk utilization percentage across all nodes. Shows the worst-case node.

panels.title: Cluster Memory Usage
panels.description: Total cluster memory working set vs allocatable memory capacity

panels.title: Cluster CPU Usage
panels.description: Total cluster CPU usage vs allocatable CPU cores

panels.title: Cluster Pod Count
panels.description: Running pod count vs allocatable pod capacity across the cluster

panels.title: CPU — Requests vs Limits vs Usage vs Allocatable
panels.description: Cluster-wide CPU: actual usage compared to total requested, limited, and allocatable capacity. Shows whether the cluster is overcommitted

panels.title: Memory — Requests vs Limits vs Usage vs Allocatable
panels.description: Cluster-wide memory: actual working set compared to total requested, limited, and allocatable capacity. Shows whether the cluster is overcommitted

panels.title: Pod Phase Distribution
panels.description: Distribution of pods across lifecycle phases (Pending=1, Running=2, Succeeded=3, Failed=4, Unknown=5)

panels.title: Container Restarts
panels.description: Container restart count over time by namespace and pod. See the Namespace dashboard for per-namespace detail.

panels.title: OOM Kills
panels.description: Containers currently in OOMKilled state across selected namespaces

panels.title: Container Status Reasons
panels.description: Container status reason counts over time — tracks OOM kills, crash loops, and image pull errors

panels.title: Total Deployments
panels.description: Total number of deployments across all namespaces

panels.title: Total StatefulSets
panels.description: Total number of StatefulSets across all namespaces

panels.title: Total DaemonSets
panels.description: Total number of DaemonSets across all namespaces

panels.title: Healthy Deployments
panels.description: Deployments where available replicas equal desired replicas

panels.title: Healthy StatefulSets
panels.description: StatefulSets where ready pods equal desired pods

panels.title: Healthy DaemonSets
panels.description: DaemonSets where ready nodes equal desired scheduled nodes

panels.title: Unhealthy Deployments
panels.description: Deployments where available replicas are less than desired

panels.title: Unhealthy StatefulSets
panels.description: StatefulSets where ready pods are less than desired

panels.title: Unhealthy DaemonSets
panels.description: DaemonSets where ready nodes are less than desired, or with misscheduled nodes

panels.title: Worst Availability
panels.description: Worst-case deployment availability across the cluster over the selected window (available / desired). Use to establish SLA baselines and measure Spot vs On-Demand impact.

panels.title: Namespaces < 95%
panels.description: Number of namespaces with average deployment availability below 95% (critical) over the selected window

panels.title: Namespaces 95–99.5%
panels.description: Number of namespaces with average deployment availability between 95% and 99.5% (warning) over the selected window

targets.expr: count((avg by ("k8s.namespace.name")(avg_over_time(({__name__="k8s.deployment.available", "k8s.namespace.name"=~"$namespace"} / {__name__="k8s.deployment.desired", "k8s.namespace.name"=~"$namespace"})[${availability_window}:5m])) >= 0.95) and (avg by ("k8s.namespace.name")(avg_over_time(({__name__="k8s.deployment.available", "k8s.namespace.name"=~"$namespace"} / {__name__="k8s.deployment.desired", "k8s.namespace.name"=~"$namespace"})[${availability_window}:5m])) < 0.995)) or vector(0)

panels.title: Namespaces ≥ 99.5%
panels.description: Number of namespaces with average deployment availability at or above 99.5% (healthy) over the selected window

panels.title: Unhealthy Workloads
panels.description: All workloads (Deployments, StatefulSets, DaemonSets) with fewer ready/available replicas than desired. Empty table means everything is healthy

panels.title: Namespace Resource Statistics
panels.description: Availability color thresholds: Green >= 99.5%, Yellow >= 95%, Red < 95%. Calculated over the selected Availability Window using Deployment and StatefulSet readiness.

panels.title: Node Information Detail
panels.description: Per-node resource utilization summary including CPU, memory, disk percentages, and allocatable capacity

panels.title: Active Job Pods
panels.description: Number of active pods across all jobs. Empty if no jobs are running

panels.title: Failed Job Pods
panels.description: Number of failed pods across all jobs. Empty if no jobs exist

panels.title: Successful Job Pods
panels.description: Number of successfully completed pods across all jobs. Empty if no jobs exist

panels.title: Active CronJobs
panels.description: Number of currently active CronJob instances. Empty if no CronJobs configured

panels.title: Total HPAs
panels.description: Total number of Horizontal Pod Autoscalers

panels.title: HPAs at Max Replicas
panels.description: HPAs where current replicas equal max replicas, indicating potential resource pressure

panels.title: HPAs at Min Replicas
panels.description: HPAs where current replicas equal min replicas

panels.title: HPAs at Max Replicas
panels.description: HPAs running at maximum replica count, which may indicate insufficient scaling headroom. Empty table means no HPAs are maxed out

panels.title: HPA Replicas Over Time
panels.description: HPA scaling pressure: desired vs current replica counts over time, bounded by min and max limits
